content.short: Moose is FastLane's DeFi aggregator and execution venue on Monad.
content.description: Moose is the aggregator and execution venue built by FastLane on Monad, searching supported pools and markets to route and split swaps across them. It sits alongside FastLane's validator-side work on Monad, which gives the team an unusual view of how order flow and block building interact on the network.
